title: Arrays & strings
theory: An array stores elements accessed by index. For N elements, valid indexes run from 0 through N-1. Keep the length alongside the data; C does not automatically prevent out-of-bounds access.
A C string is a sequence of characters terminated by a null character. Space for N visible characters needs room for that terminator. A bounded input read limits how many characters reach the buffer.
A single pass can count matches, total values, or find a first match. Decide what state you need to carry between iterations. Do not print a result until you know enough to compute it.

An array index is a position, not the stored value. Explicitly specify whether search returns a value, a boolean, or an index. The automated exercises test behavior; review your array bounds separately.
